text: COmparisons being odious, I only say, divines have cause to give learned gentlemen their due, and thank for their labours, but also cause to complain, when they are too bold with boly things, not only with the commonwealth of the Hebrews, the form that God then appointed, but also with the government of the Christian church, the form and Edition: current; Page: [529] functions left by Christ and his apostles, according to which the church acted three hundred years before the civil power became Christian.
